metadata.database: A Deeper China | Chengdu decision layer

CDM01.guest_need: A visitor wants Chengdu to feel like a rhythm, not a rush between attractions.
CDM01.hidden_need: Protect unprogrammed sitting, eating and recovery time.
CDM01.why_this_over_nearby_alternative: One city-rhythm anchor gives Chengdu a readable identity before adding another district.
CDM01.stop_condition: The guest has experienced one public-life rhythm and does not need another commercial street to prove the city.
CDM01.low_energy_branch: Keep one public-life loop and a long seated break.
CDM01.rain_branch: Use indoor cultural or food layers while preserving the slower pace.
CDM01.body_cost: Low-to-moderate walking; heat, humidity and unstructured time determine success.

CDM02.guest_need: A visitor needs to decide whether Panda Base deserves the early start and half-day.
CDM02.hidden_need: Prevent animal expectations, crowds and transfer cost from consuming the whole Chengdu plan.
CDM02.why_this_over_nearby_alternative: One verified panda question is enough; the rest of the day should not be filled by another distant attraction.
CDM02.stop_condition: The guest has completed the planned conservation/animal question and a realistic exit.
CDM02.low_energy_branch: Leave after the planned panda segment and keep the rest of the day nearby.
CDM02.rain_branch: Use only after current admission, weather and animal-activity conditions are checked.
CDM02.body_cost: Low-to-moderate walking but high early-start, reservation and crowd friction.

CDM03.guest_need: A visitor wants Chengdu’s slow-city feeling to become observable in public life.
CDM03.hidden_need: Offer unstructured time without pretending a particular tea table or local encounter is guaranteed.
CDM03.why_this_over_nearby_alternative: One park/tea structure explains shared public time better than adding another landmark.
CDM03.stop_condition: The guest has observed sitting, conversation and pace without staging strangers.
CDM03.low_energy_branch: Stay within one park and preserve the whole recovery block.
CDM03.rain_branch: Use a covered tea or cultural layer after opening is confirmed.
CDM03.body_cost: Low transfer cost; heat, rain, seating and etiquette matter more than distance.

CDM04.guest_need: A visitor wants Sichuan food explained through ordering, spice and social format.
CDM04.hidden_need: Make dietary, shared-pot and language risks explicit before recommending a meal.
CDM04.why_this_over_nearby_alternative: One meal or snack progression is more useful than a ranked restaurant list.
CDM04.stop_condition: One safe, understood food format is complete; no food crawl is needed.
CDM04.low_energy_branch: Keep one confirmed food context and remove the second meal stop.
CDM04.rain_branch: Food is a strong weather branch after written dietary and venue checks.
CDM04.body_cost: Low walking but high dietary, spice, waiting and communication sensitivity.

CDM05.guest_need: A visitor wants Chengdu beyond pandas and food through memory, poetry or religion.
CDM05.hidden_need: Choose one cultural lens instead of stacking Wuhou, Du Fu and Wenshu.
CDM05.why_this_over_nearby_alternative: One cultural anchor can answer a memory or poetry question better than three partially visited sites.
CDM05.stop_condition: The selected cultural lens has changed the guest’s reading of Chengdu.
CDM05.low_energy_branch: Choose one cultural anchor and stop before a second temple or memorial.
CDM05.rain_branch: Protect the confirmed indoor/covered core and remove the garden extension.
CDM05.body_cost: Low-to-moderate walking with attention and etiquette requirements.

CDM06.guest_need: A visitor wants present-day Chengdu through one contemporary district, night or performance.
CDM06.hidden_need: Match mood and programme before adding late return risk.
CDM06.why_this_over_nearby_alternative: One current-city question is deeper than a gallery or nightlife crawl.
CDM06.stop_condition: A current programme or public-space mood has answered the visitor’s contemporary question.
CDM06.low_energy_branch: Keep one confirmed evening layer and return early.
CDM06.rain_branch: Use one confirmed indoor programme, not venue-hopping.
CDM06.body_cost: Moderate evening load with programme, crowd and return-transport uncertainty.

CDM07.guest_need: A visitor needs to decide whether to leave Chengdu for a full western-Sichuan day.
CDM07.hidden_need: Ensure water engineering, mountain time or panda purpose earns the transfer.
CDM07.why_this_over_nearby_alternative: A day trip is a new question, not proof that Chengdu itself is insufficient.
CDM07.stop_condition: The visitor has one verified excursion purpose, transport plan and weather fallback.
CDM07.low_energy_branch: Stay in Chengdu rather than forcing a thin excursion.
CDM07.rain_branch: Release only after current transport, weather and site conditions are checked.

CDM08.guest_need: A visitor needs Chengdu and Chongqing to work as a contrast, not a rushed bundle.
CDM08.hidden_need: Protect minimum nights, rail timing and the difference between dwelling and vertical intensity.
CDM08.why_this_over_nearby_alternative: The handoff is valuable only when the second city adds a genuinely different question.
CDM08.stop_condition: The guest has a sequence, minimum stay and transfer cost they accept.
CDM08.rain_branch: Use current rail and indoor programme conditions before changing cities.
CDM08.body_cost: Transfer fatigue and hotel/rail timing are the main costs.
